scope: Only3newly authored E-facing gait poses. No other direction/role, completed actor, runtime import or actual Main test.

gait_evidence.anatomical_assignment: In this E profile, anatomicalRIGHT is the near leg and anatomicalLEFT the far leg. This is a visual assignment from hip/puffed-breeches occlusion and near/far shading, not merely the screen-space leading-foot position.
gait_evidence.phase0: The large vertical near puff/bright near shin stay behind as the support leg; the forward bent thigh emerges from behind that near hip as the farLEFT swing leg. Far thigh is occluded at its origin by the near supporting breeches.
gait_evidence.phase1: Legs pass closer beneath the pelvis; one boot supports while the trailing heel lifts. The hip/knee/ankle arrangement differs from the two open stride poses. The overlapping breeches obscure an exact anatomical label for each passing leg, so phase1 trace names intentionally describe grounded/trailing roles only.
gait_evidence.phase2: The large forward horizontal puff/thigh now overlaps in front of the other hip as the nearRIGHT swing leg, while the darker farLEFT leg supports behind. The near/far thigh overlap order reverses fromphase0.
gait_evidence.conclusion: Opposite anatomical swing/support legs are sufficiently visible in this small pilot; this is stronger evidence than merely seeing a forward knee inphase0/2.
gait_evidence.confidence_limit: Anatomical labels derive from the static painted overlap/shading. No rig bone IDs, continuous video, foot pressure data or engine skeleton exists in these PNGs.

other_visual_checks.facing_identity: All3 retain the clear rightward E mask/nose profile, source white/black carnival mask, ruff, purple/gold short jacket and puffed breeches, red stockings and dark shoes.
other_visual_checks.held_wand: Same visible near/right holding hand, connected wrist/grip/shaft and complete violet orb across all3; no hand transfer or literal direction reversal.
other_visual_checks.connections: Both hip-to-knee-to-ankle chains remain connected; no detached limb or full-body airborne pose was observed.
other_visual_checks.alpha: No broad visible haze/matte/halo; sparse edge/fringe diagnostics recorded below.

ground_anchor_followup.finding: Source lowest support-sole y differs across phases. Review per-pose foot-root anchors before any later import; an E-only source trial does not establish a shared in-game ground baseline.

new_face_expression_claim_limit: Small mask expressions/teeth are newly authored interpretations, not verified original-game facts.
